name: Planar layer filling
summary: Planar boundary loops and region-grouped raster fill, inset by wall count around rectangular, circular, annular and holed boundaries.

evidence.label: EXPERIMENTAL
evidence.scope: Deterministic generator validated by schema, geometry-bounds, and golden-output tests. Not yet evidenced on physical hardware under this exact manifest and generator revision.

wallCount.description: Number of boundary loops, applied to rectangular/circular outer walls and bore/hole walls. Circular fill is inset by beadWidth/2 + wallCount*spacing from each nominal boundary.

infillDensity.description: Rectangular geometry only. Approximate single-layer fill coverage fraction (bead width / line spacing) — a rough rectilinear-infill density model, not evidence specific to this project. Omit to keep the previous behavior of filling at settings.spacing directly.

solidBottomLayers.description: Rectangular geometry only. This many layers from the bottom are filled at full density (spacing == beadWidth) regardless of infillDensity.

solidTopLayers.description: Rectangular geometry only. This many layers from the top are filled at full density regardless of infillDensity.

boreDiameter.description: Rectangular geometry only. A centered cylindrical bore into the top face — distinct from innerDiameter's full-through annulus, which only applies to circular/annular geometry. Requires boreDepth.

boreDepth.description: Depth of boreDiameter's bore, measured down from the top face. Cuts through walls, the bore's own inner-perimeter walls, and fill alike on every affected layer, regardless of that layer's solid/sparse classification — a bore open at the top face has to stay open through any solid top layers too. For a blind hole (boreDepth less than the part's full height), the solidTopLayers count of layers immediately below the floor is automatically forced solid too, since the floor is a top-facing surface exactly like the part's own outer top.

holes.description: Circular/annular geometry only. Through-holes at arbitrary positions in the face — a flange's bolt circle, for example. Distinct from both innerDiameter (exactly one concentric annulus) and boreDiameter (exactly one centered, possibly partial-depth bore in a rectangular part): these are a set, each with its own center, and each runs the full height of this invocation. Every hole is walled with wallCount perimeters and then excluded from fill out to its own wall allowance. Positions are in the operation's own coordinate frame, whose origin is the circular geometry's center; a hole that reaches past the outer edge, or that overlaps the bore wall, is dropped with a warning rather than clamped.

inputs.description: A request with a finite `outerDiameter`/`diameter`, or `geometry` set to "circle"/"annulus", resolves to a circular/annular perimeter with raster fill clipped to that boundary, optionally with `holes` cut through it. Otherwise it resolves to a rectangular perimeter with raster fill clipped to `width`/`depth`, optionally with a centered bore and/or solid top/bottom layers. Either way the raster alternates direction by layer — see README.md.

validation.description: Every emitted point stays within the declared part envelope.
The number of distinct layer indices equals the requested layer count.
Every perimeter/ring/fill-ring path's first and last point coincide.
No fill or perimeter point falls inside a requested hole, and each hole's own perimeters are centered on it. A hole that doesn't fit the material is reported as a warning and dropped, never clamped.
